description: Permissions for the main window. Keep this minimal: the UI talks to alchemyd over HTTP, not Tauri commands. Beyond core:default it may only open https: links and apps' http: web addresses in the default browser, set the title bar's light or dark theme, read alchemyd's TCP token to sign its requests, read whether the shell is starting alchemyd, and ask it to start alchemyd again. The tray is built in Rust and needs no permission.
